Yorishiroは、Model Context ProtocolをStreamable HTTPで `/mcp` に公開します。APIキーは `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>` ヘッダーで送ります。

どのツールにも、呼び出しに必要な最小のスコープがあります。スコープは `read`、`write`、`schema`、`migration` の順に高くなり、高いスコープのキーは低いスコープのツールもすべて呼び出せます。スコープが足りない呼び出しは、プロトコルエラーではなくツールのエラーとして返ります。

`localhost` 以外のホスト名でサーバーにアクセスするクライアントがある場合は、そのホスト名を `YORISHIRO_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS` にカンマ区切りで追加します。詳しくは[設定](../../configuration/)を参照してください。

実際に使えるツールは、MCPクライアントが一覧で取得できます。このページには現在のリリースのツールを載せています。

ツールとパラメーターの説明は、サーバーが返す英語のまま掲載しています。

## Communityのツール

### create_entity

Create a new entity.

必要なスコープ: `write`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | any | はい | Entity body (JSON object) conforming to the schema's `fields` definition. |
| `entity_type` | string | はい | entity_type name declared in the schema. |
| `schema_name` | string | はい | Name of the schema this entity conforms to. The workspace's current active version is used. |

### create_relation

Create a relation between two entities. Properties cannot be edited in place; to change them, delete the relation and recreate it. To retire a relation without losing the record that it existed, use set_relation_status instead of deleting.

必要なスコープ: `write`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `properties` | any | いいえ | Arbitrary properties attached to the relation (JSON object, defaults to an empty object if omitted). |
| `relation_type` | string | はい | relation_type name declared in the schema's `relation_types` definition. |
| `source_id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |
| `target_id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

### create_schema

Register a new schema, or add a new version to an existing schema.

必要なスコープ: `schema`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `definition` | any | いいえ | JSON object conforming to `MetaSchemaDefinition` (name/description/entity_types/relation_types). If a schema with the same name already exists, whether the change is breaking or non-breaking is detected automatically and it is registered as a new version. Mutually exclusive with `template_id`; exactly one of the two must be set. |
| `template_id` | string or null | いいえ | ID of a template to use as the definition instead of supplying one inline. A UUID names one from the tenant's own library (see `list_template_library`); anything else names a built-in (see `list_templates`). Mutually exclusive with `definition`; exactly one of the two must be set. |

### delete_entity

Delete an entity.

必要なスコープ: `write`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

### delete_relation

Delete a relation.

必要なスコープ: `write`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

### fill_defaults

Fill absent required fields in entities behind a schema's active version. Takes a snapshot so the operation can be undone with the migration undo endpoint.

必要なスコープ: `migration`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_name` | string | はい | Name of the schema whose active version supplies the missing fields. |

### get_active_schema

Get the currently active schema definition by name.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | はい |  |

### get_entity

Get a single entity by ID.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

### get_entity_drift

Report how an entity stands against the active version of its schema. Entities are migrated lazily, so one written against an older version simply lacks fields added since. Use this to tell an absent field apart from an unfilled one before answering from the entity's data.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

### get_entity_type_json_schema

Get a specific entity_type within the active schema as a JSON Schema. Use this to let an agent learn field types, required fields, enums, etc. ahead of time.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entity_type` | string | はい | entity_type name within that schema. |
| `schema_name` | string | はい | Name of the active schema. |

### get_relation

Get a single relation by ID.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

### get_schema_by_id

Get a specific version of a schema definition by ID.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

### get_template_library_item

Get a single template from the tenant's DB-backed template library by ID.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

### import_jsonl

Bulk-import schemas/entities/relations from a JSON Lines document in the export format. Runs as a single transaction: either every record in `jsonl` is applied, or the first error rolls back everything imported so far.

必要なスコープ: `schema`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jsonl` | string | はい | JSON Lines document in the same format `export_jsonl`/`GET /api/export.jsonl` produces: one `{"kind":"schema"\|"entity"\|"relation","record":{...}}` object per line, newline-separated. |

### list_entities

List entities.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entity_type` | string or null | いいえ |  |
| `filter` | any | いいえ | JSONB containment filter matched against entity data, e.g. `{"status": "active"}`. |
| `limit` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Maximum number of results (defaults to 50 if omitted). |
| `offset` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Number of records to skip (defaults to 0 if omitted). |
| `schema_version` | integer (int32) or null | いいえ | Restricts results to entities created against this schema version. |

### list_relations

List relations.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Maximum number of results (defaults to 50 if omitted). |
| `offset` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Number of records to skip (defaults to 0 if omitted). |
| `relation_type` | string or null | いいえ |  |
| `source_id` | string (uuid) or null | いいえ |  |
| `status` | string or null | いいえ | Restricts the listing to one state ("active", "deprecated" or "archived"). Omitted, every state is listed. |
| `target_id` | string (uuid) or null | いいえ |  |

### list_schemas

List summaries of all schemas registered for the workspace (all versions, including archived). Use this to discover what schemas exist.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Maximum number of results (defaults to 50 if omitted). |
| `offset` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Number of records to skip (defaults to 0 if omitted). |

### list_template_library

List the tenant's DB-backed schema template library (own templates plus any community-visible ones). Distinct from `list_templates`, which lists the built-in templates shipped with the server.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Maximum number of results (defaults to 50 if omitted). |
| `offset` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Number of records to skip (defaults to 0 if omitted). |

### list_templates

List built-in schema templates that can be used as a starting point for create_schema instead of writing a definition from scratch.

必要なスコープ: `read`

このツールにパラメーターはありません。

### migration_dry_run

Count what migrating a schema's entities to its active version would face, without doing it. Reports how many are current, how many are behind but still valid, and how many lack a field the active version requires: the last being the work a migration would have to fill in.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | はい |  |

### recall_context

Fetch an entity's full body together with its relations and connected neighbors, up to `depth` hops away, in one call.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `depth` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | How many hops to traverse outward from the entity (defaults to 1, max 3). |
| `entity_id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |
| `full` | boolean or null | いいえ | When true, neighbor entities include every field instead of only `x-embed` fields (defaults to false). |
| `limit` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Maximum number of relations/neighbors to include per hop (defaults to 20 if omitted). |

### search_entities

Vector similarity search over entities using a natural-language query.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entity_type` | string or null | いいえ |  |
| `filter` | any | いいえ | JSONB containment filter matched against entity data, e.g. `{"status": "active"}`. |
| `limit` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Upper bound on the number of results returned (defaults to 10 if omitted). |
| `query_text` | string | はい | Natural-language query text. Vectorized via the embedding provider and matched against entities' `x-embed` field by cosine distance. Also used, as-is, for an auxiliary pg_trgm fuzzy text match against entities that have no embedding. |

### set_relation_status

Set a relation's status to active, deprecated or archived. Retiring a relation this way keeps the record that it existed, which delete_relation does not; graph traversal follows active relations only.

必要なスコープ: `write`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |
| `status` | string | はい | "active", "deprecated" or "archived". Traversal follows "active" relations only. |

### update_entity

Replace the data of an existing entity.

必要なスコープ: `write`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | any | はい | Replacement entity body. Validated against the schema version in effect when the entity was created. |
| `id` | string (uuid) | はい |  |

## Enterpriseのツール

これらのツールはEnterprise版でのみ使えます。

### list_upstream_changes

List schemas in this workspace whose origin template has changed since the schema was last copied. Use this to discover which schemas have pending upstream updates that have not yet been merged.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Maximum number of results (defaults to 50 if omitted). |
| `offset` | integer (int64) or null | いいえ | Number of records to skip (defaults to 0 if omitted). |

### merge_apply

Merge the origin template into a schema, writing the merged definition as the schema's next version. Returns the new schema version and a diff describing whether the merge was breaking. Fails if there are merge conflicts.

必要なスコープ: `schema`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_id` | string (uuid) | はい | ID of the schema to merge. |

### merge_preview

Preview what merging the origin template would do to a schema. Returns a list of fields that would be added, updated, kept, or conflicted. Does not write anything.

必要なスコープ: `read`

| パラメーター | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_id` | string (uuid) | はい | ID of the schema to preview a merge for. |
